cases.summary: Proposed class action filed by Clarkson Law Firm accusing Oura of misleading consumers about the sleep-tracking accuracy of the Oura Ring. Seeks injunctive relief and restitution for consumers who purchased based on the allegedly false claims. This is a same-day filing — no settlement, administrator, deadline, or claim form exists yet. There is nothing to claim right now; this entry exists so you can see it early, not to suggest otherwise.
cases.sourceName: TechCrunch report, cross-checked directly against the federal docket (CourtListener)
